svg.title: macOS · Gallery · the Approved view, nothing approved · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors GalleryGridContent.approvedEmptyState (App/GalleryGridContent.swift, 2026-11-05; docs/approved-assets.md) — gallery.approved.svg's view in a library where nothing is approved, or where the other filters leave no approved output: the sidebar's APPROVED row lit with a count of 0, and in the grid column the empty state — checkmark.seal at largeTitle in secondary, Nothing approved (.headline: 13 pt bold on the Mac), and the hint in .footnote secondary (10 pt on the Mac), centred, at most 320 pt wide: Approve a photo, a clip or a blended clip from its Output section, and it shows here — ready for use. A VStack(spacing: 12), centred in the column. Nothing is selected, so there is no pane and the column runs to the window's right edge. Drawn from the code (the scratch library always holds an approval once one is given; clearing them all shows this). The header is gallery.svg's row with no pane beside it: the column is 331 pt wider and the row's two Spacers share that, so the title sits 165.5 pt further right and the search · sort · zoom · Timeline cluster and the sync pill 331, ending flush 16 pt from the window's edge. The sidebar's PICPLACE counts are gallery.svg's. The family's known offset stands (INDEX.md, 2026-11-05).

g.data-symbol: camera.fill + a slash knocked through (no SF camera.slash)

g.text: Approve a photo, a clip or a blended clip from its Output section,
and it shows here — ready for use.
